category: Figure Matrix (Class A vs Class B Dot Position)
question_text: Class A contains figures where a single solid dot is placed OUTSIDE the shape. Class B contains figures where a single solid dot is placed INSIDE the shape. Which option belongs to Class A?

reference_figures.label: Class A Example
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='20' cy='20' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>

reference_figures.label: Class B Example
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='20' y='20' width='60' height='60' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>

options.label: A
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,20 80,80 20,80' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='60' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>

options.label: B
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='30' y='30' width='40' height='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='85' cy='15' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>

options.label: C
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='30' r='5' fill='black'/></svg>

explanation: Class A specifically requires the black dot to be floating outside the perimeter of the primary geometric shape. Option B displays a square with a dot situated entirely outside its top-right corner.

question_text: Find if the two cubes are alike. Write 'Yes' or 'No'.

reference_figures.label: Cube 1
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='6' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>X</text><rect x='73' y='42' width='10' height='10' fill='black'/></svg>

reference_figures.label: Cube 2
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='45' y='45' width='10' height='10' fill='black'/><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>X</text><circle cx='76' cy='45' r='6' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/></svg>

explanation: In Cube 1, reading clockwise around the shared vertex yields X -> Solid Square -> Hollow Circle. In Cube 2, the order around that same vertex is X -> Hollow Circle -> Solid Square. The sequence is reversed, meaning they are mirror images, not identical.
